definitions.explanation: A liquid dish, especially a Japanese-style soup such as miso soup.
The liquid extracted from fruits, vegetables, meat, or other ingredients.

examples.japanese: {味噌|みそ}{汁|しる}を{作|つく}る。
{朝|あさ}ごはんに{温|あたた}かい{汁物|しるもの}があると{嬉|うれ}しい。
examples.english: It's nice to have warm soup with breakfast.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}の{汁|しる}がたっぷり{出|で}て、とても{美味|おい}しかった。
examples.english: Lots of juice came out of the meat, and it was very delicious.

notes:
{汁|しる} refers to liquid food (soup/broth) or the juice/sap from ingredients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {味噌|みそ}{汁|しる}: miso soup
- {汁物|しるもの}: soup dish (general term for Japanese soups)
- {果|か}{汁|じゅう}: fruit juice (read as かじゅう)
- レモン{汁|じる}: lemon juice

Note: The reading changes in some compounds: {汁|しる} in standalone and native compounds, {汁|じる} in some food terms like レモン{汁|じる}, and {汁|じゅう} in Sino-Japanese compounds like {果汁|かじゅう}.
